en: Room {number} of fourteen. Something stirs behind the door on the left...
Room {number} of fourteen. Something stirs behind the middle door...
Room {number} of fourteen. Something stirs behind the door on the right...
I can feel people waiting in there. Someone eager, I think.
It feels nostalgic, somehow. Like something from long ago.
I can hear whispering. Quiet voices, just behind the wall.
I sense Pokémon in there. Strong ones, and restless.
Room {number}... Oh! The same presence fills every door at once.
The Pike Queen is waiting. Whichever door you take, you'll meet her.
